Support the Riftn ecosystem

About Riftn

Riftn is a non-profit, decentralised, user-owned protocol. All net profit is used to buy back and share Riftn tokens with stakeholders.

All revenue is spent in accordance with DAO proposals, ensuring 100% reinvestment into the ecosystem. Riftn will forever be maintained as a public good through revenue and donations.

Contribute through the DAO

The EVM address above is the DAO treasury. Send Riftn tokens to it from the app and your contribution is counted towards your share of the pool, which is the weight your vote carries when the DAO decides how it is spent.
